text:
tanya: flagging AP-SOUTH-1 node join failures after role-boundary enforcement this morning — observed during scheduled rollout window :exclamation:
infra-bot: ALERT: node-join-errors (ap-south-1) 1745678899  12 nodes failing to pull images
matt: symptom? image pull auth or boot-time decrypt?
tanya: image auth. kubelet logs show STS assume role failing at bootstrap when trying to get ECR creds. snippet:
```
2026-03-21T08:04:12Z kubelet bootstrap: http transport error: retrieving credentials failed: sts:AssumeRole for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/node-role-ap-south-1 denied by permissions boundary
2026-03-21T08:04:12Z container runtime: pulling image 123456789012.dkr.ecr.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/gpu-runtime:2026-03-21 failed: unauthorized
```
oliver: ah - role-boundary policy rb-2026-03-21 was applied at 1745676000 across accounts to lock down cross-account assume. policy-bot: Policy rb-2026-03-21 enforced 1745676000. Enforcement scope: all instance roles. Reversion requires security approval.
devin: that boundary inadvertently strips sts:AssumeRole to the node role's internal ECR access role (we scoped to allow only specific role ARNs and forgot the regional node role mapping).
ops-bot: OBSERVED: autoscaler behaviour - scaled up then nodes stuck in ImagePullBackOff -> scaled down; warm pool churn causing capacity hole and brief latency spike for customers.
finance-bot: preliminary cost calc: fallback to public mirror registries + cross-region pulls increased data transfer and on-demand image pull retries. Estimated delta +31% egress cost for ap-south-1 in last 45m.
matt: additionally noticed a CloudTrail delivery gap for the same window. console shows PutObject errors writing logs to audit-bucket due to S3 ACL mismatch after a concurrent bucket policy tweak. audit events may be incomplete.
security-bot: Security note: any temporary exceptions must be logged and ticketed for compliance.
tanya: mitigation proposal (quick): 1) add a narrow exception to rb-2026-03-21 to allow sts:AssumeRole for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/node-role-ap-south-1 2) push a short-lived bootstrap image with baked ECR auth token cache 3) pause autoscaler scale-ins for 20m to stop churn
oliver: command to reapply trust (short-lived): `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name node-role-ap-south-1 --policy-name temp-assume-exception --policy-document '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ecr-access-node"}]}'`
devin: we'll avoid editing the boundary itself; instead create a boundary-exception role and attach it to the instance profile via instance-profile-update in a controlled maintenance window. need security sign-off for boundary exceptions.
matt: ops: also re-enable CloudTrail delivery by rolling back the bucket policy that removed the PutObject ACL. current errors in cloudtrail S3 writes: `AccessDenied: PutObject` 1745678955
ops-bot: running impact checks for 15m.
finance-bot: please include cost delta in ticket, tagging billing and product.
security-bot: temporary exception approved pending audit log of change and two approvers. Please use change id RB-EXC-174567 and include justification.
tanya: applying exception to instance profile now; will monitor node joins.
ops-bot: 1745678975: instance-profile patch RB-EXC-174567 applied by oliver  validation in progress
devin: nodes are now able to pull from internal ECR; joining: 2 -> 10 in 3m. warm pool stabilizing.
matt: re-enabled cloudtrail writes at 1745678999. backfilling logs started.
security-bot: Note: RB exception will be auto-revoked in 1h unless extended. File a postmortem and include why mapping matrix missed ap-south-1 role.
ops-bot: monitoring for 1h window; autoscaler pause set to 20m.
oliver: filing INFRA-4201 with timeline, rollouts, cost delta, and remediation items (bake auth cache; add role mapping to boundary onboarding docs).
tanya: follow-ups: security to update boundary onboarding checklist, infra to add region-role test in canary job, eng-sre to validate warm-pool behaviour in next release.
finance-bot: logging cost line items to INFRA-4201.
ops-bot: resolved? provisional mitigations in place. continuing to monitor metrics (node-joins, image-pull errors, audit backfill).
